lead_raw_text:
The structure of LiAsS₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Pmm2 (No. 25), with a unit cell containing four atoms and four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows As centers with three S neighbors (2.0783–2.2456 Å), Li centers with six S neighbors (2.2257–2.6856 Å), and S centers with either one As neighbor or two Li neighbors. The geometric neighbor graph is two-dimensional, and validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner-sharing between the 6-vertex Li and 3-vertex As polyhedra.
